class.name: VoxelTerrainNavigation
class.brief_description: A [TiledNavigation3D] that also follows the [VoxelTerrain] it's a child of.
class.description: Add as a child of a [VoxelTerrain]. Tiles are columns of [member tile_size_blocks] mesh blocks (so [member TiledNavigation3D.tile_size] isn't used), on the terrain's grid, and bake the terrain's own triangles along with the fixed geometry. When voxels change (edited, or streamed in) only the tiles they reach are rebaked; a block streaming out leaves its tiles as they were, since its voxels haven't changed: an edit reports the box it touched, so one inside a tile leaves its neighbours alone. Walkable parts of the fixed geometry that voxels now bury are dropped (see [member drop_buried_static_geometry]), so filling a road in takes it off the navmesh and digging it out puts it back. The terrain's [code]bounds[/code] set the tiles' vertical extent, together with the fixed geometry's. Only a translation and uniform scale on the terrain are supported.

members.member: If true, walkable fixed triangles with solid voxels half the agent's height above them are left out of the bake. A baker sees only surfaces, not what is solid between them, so a road under a deep fill would otherwise still read as a walkable floor with the fill's top for a ceiling.
Width of a tile, in mesh blocks.
